summary_en: This study tests DS-1103a, given alone at increasing doses and then with T-DXd, in adults with advanced solid tumors. Later, DS-1103a is given with T-DXd to people with specific HER2-altered advanced solid tumor types. Both drugs are given as an IV infusion every 3 weeks (each cycle is 21 days), and the total duration is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome; it says the study will evaluate safety and efficacy, and the study is Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa DS-1103a, administrado solo en dosis crecientes y luego junto con T-DXd, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. Más adelante, DS-1103a se administra con T-DXd a personas con tipos específicos de tumores sólidos avanzados con alteraciones de HER2. Ambos medicamentos se dan por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas (cada ciclo dura 21 días), y la duración total no se indica. El registro no indica un resultado principal; dice que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, y el estudio es de Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who signed informed consent.
HER2-expressing or HER2-mutated solid tumor that is unresectable or metastatic.
At least one measurable lesion on CT or MRI by RECIST v1.1.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Prior treatment with an anti-CD47 or anti-SIRPα therapy.
Prior antibody-drug conjugate with an exatecan derivative (topoisomerase I inhibitor) in the expansion phase.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids, or current ILD or pneumonitis.
Active or uncontrolled HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C, or uncontrolled infection needing IV antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals.
